name: Divider
summary: A thin horizontal or vertical line separating groups of content, optionally with a short label set into it. Choose emphasis by appearance (strong > default > subtle; brand for accent); prefer spacing alone where it separates clearly enough.

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: Optional label content set into the line. Without it the divider is a plain line.

inputs.name: vertical
inputs.description: Draw a vertical line in a row instead of a horizontal one.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: Line and label colour: Stroke 2 / Foreground 2 by default, Stroke 3 / Foreground 3 subtle, Stroke 1 / Foreground 1 strong, brand stroke and foreground for brand.

inputs.name: alignContent
inputs.description: Where the label sits along the line; start and end leave an 8px stub of line before or after it.

inputs.name: inset
inputs.description: Pull both ends of the line in by 12px.

anatomy.name: Divider
anatomy.description: A flex box that grows along its axis and holds the two line segments and the label.

anatomy.name: Line before
anatomy.description: The root's ::before pseudo-element: a line segment that grows to fill the space before the label.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: The wrapper holding children, in caption-sized text.

anatomy.name: Line after
anatomy.description: The root's ::after pseudo-element: a line segment that grows to fill the space after the label.

variants.description: Full width; the segments draw a top border.
A column at least 20px tall (84px with a label); the segments draw a right border.
An 8px stub, the label, then the growing segment.
Two growing segments either side of the label.
The growing segment, the label, then an 8px stub.

layout.text: The root is a flex box that grows along its parent, centring its children on the cross axis; horizontal takes the full width, vertical is a column at least 20px tall, or 84px when it has a label.

Each segment is a flex item that grows; horizontal draws a strokeWidthThin solid top border and is at least 8px wide, vertical a strokeWidthThin solid right border at least 8px tall. line-after follows the same rule.
With a label, 12px separates each segment from it; without one the margins are zero and the two segments meet as one line.
alignContent start caps the leading segment and end the trailing one at 8px, so the label sits near that end; horizontal start and end also align the label's text left and right.
inset pulls the line in by 12px at each end: horizontal as left and right padding, vertical as top and bottom margin.
The label text is fontFamilyBase, fontSizeBase200, fontWeightRegular on lineHeightBase200, centred, in the appearance's foreground.

states.text: A divider has one look per appearance and no interactive states.
Not focusable; draws no focus indicator.

behaviour.text: The divider takes no input and does not animate.

keyboard: None; not in the tab order
semantics: role separator, with aria-orientation vertical when vertical
a labelled divider's text is read as content

notes.text: The 12px label gap and inset, the 8px minimum segment and stub length, and the vertical minimum heights (20px, 84px with a label) are constants in the styles file; the line colour and width are tokens.

minStartEndLength is the string '8px;' with a stray semicolon, so the segments' min-width and min-height declarations are malformed; in the browser the minimum may not apply. Build the 8px minimum as intended.
Vertical inset is margin, horizontal inset is padding: a vertical inset divider is shorter in its row, a horizontal one keeps its full box and only the line is shorter.
The styles file has no forced-colours rules; the stroke and foreground aliases resolve through the high-contrast theme, and the line, being a border, stays visible.
The separator role and aria-orientation are set by the component's hook, which this kit does not vendor; the design site and ARIA practice give them.
